0.content:
# 🤖 Developers AI Usage

Visão geral de uso de IA generativa pelos devs - custo, performance, adocão e qualidade em um único dashboard, agnóstico de ferramenta.
Funciona com qualquer cliente instrumentado com OTel GenAl Semantic Conventions - GitHub Copilot Chat, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, agentes custom, etc. - desde que emita spans gen_ai. *. Nenhuma query aqui depende de service.name fixo; gen_ai.provider.name e service.name aparecem como dimensão de quebra pra comparar ferramentas lado a lado

11.title: Custo estimado (USD)
11.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(gen_ai.request.model) and not(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"embedding")) and not(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"metis"))
| filter in(gen_ai.provider.name, $Provider)
| filter in(gen_ai.request.model, $Modelo)
| fieldsAdd inp=toDouble(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens), out=toDouble(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens)
| fieldsAdd cost_usd=if(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"opus"),(inp*0.000015)+(out*0.000075),else:if(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"sonnet"),(inp*0.000003)+(out*0.000015),else:if(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"haiku"),(inp*0.0000008)+(out*0.000004),else:if(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"mini"),(inp*0.00000015)+(out*0.0000006),else:if(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"gpt-4o"),(inp*0.0000025)+(out*0.00001),else:if(contains(gen_ai.request.model,"gemini"),(inp*0.00000125)+(out*0.000005),else:(inp*0.000002)+(out*0.00001)))))))
| summarize total=sum(cost_usd)

### 🧠 Prompt caching

> Disponível onde a ferramenta reporta `gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens` (hoje, principalmente Copilot).

71.title: AVG Cache Read Tokens
71.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens)
| filter in(gen_ai.provider.name, $Provider)
| filter in(gen_ai.request.model, $Modelo)
| fieldsAdd cin=toDouble(gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens)
| summarize avg_cache=avg(cin)

72.title: Cache Hit
72.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens)
| filter in(gen_ai.provider.name, $Provider)
| filter in(gen_ai.request.model, $Modelo)
| fieldsAdd cin=toDouble(gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens), inp=toDouble(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens)
| summarize cr=sum(cin), i=sum(inp)
| fieldsAdd hit_pct=round(cr/i*100, decimals:2)
